bead.title: providers: reasoning-token telemetry fallback from message.reasoning_content
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-010 amendment (2026-05-11) §10' requires reasoning-token counts to be recovered from `message.reasoning_content` when the upstream usage block omits a reasoning-token field. Today the telemetry path reads only `usage.reasoning_tokens` (or equivalent), so providers that surface reasoning text but not a usage count report zero reasoning tokens, breaking budget accounting.

ROOT CAUSE: provider response/usage extraction code (locate via `grep -rn 'reasoning_tokens\|ReasoningTokens' internal/provider`) lacks a fallback branch that tokenizes or counts `message.reasoning_content` when the usage block lacks the count.

PROPOSED FIX: In the shared usage-extraction helper (or per-provider extractor if no shared helper exists), add a fallback: when `usage.reasoning_tokens` is absent or zero AND `message.reasoning_content` is non-empty, derive the reasoning-token count via the project's existing token-counting utility (same one used for prompt/completion tokens). Record the source (`usage` vs `content-fallback`) in any existing telemetry metadata field if one exists; otherwise no metadata change. Add focused unit test `TestReasoningTokens_FallbackFromContent` covering: (a) usage present → uses usage, (b) usage absent + content present → uses content count, (c) both absent → zero.

NON-SCOPE: ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort enum (separate child); llamaserver chat_template_kwargs envelope (separate child); changes to the tokenizer itself; new telemetry sinks or metric names; cross-provider reconciliation beyond the documented fallback.

Governing artifacts: ADR-010 amendment 2026-05-11 §10'; AR-2026-05-17-repo; source review fizeau-8e37e536.

VERIFICATION: `go test ./internal/provider/... ./... -count=1` green; lefthook hooks pass.

AC:
1) Reasoning-token extractor falls back to counting `message.reasoning_content` when usage omits the count.
2) Test `TestReasoningTokens_FallbackFromContent` covers usage-present, content-fallback, and both-absent cases.
3) When both usage and content are present, usage wins (asserted in the test).
4) `go test ./... -count=1` passes.
5) lefthook pre-commit and pre-push pass.
bead.acceptance:
1) Reasoning-token extractor implements message.reasoning_content fallback when usage omits the count.
2) TestReasoningTokens_FallbackFromContent covers usage-present, content-fallback, both-absent.
3) usage-present beats content-fallback (asserted).
4) go test ./... -count=1 green.
5) lefthook pre-commit and pre-push pass.
